body:
Use the SQLite wrapper's DSN pragma handling so settings reach new pooled connections, rather than applying a one-off PRAGMA to an arbitrary connection. Memory defaults to one connection because separate :memory: connections see separate databases. Do not override that pool size without changing the database-sharing design; Open itself does not ping, so first-use errors still need handling.

Evidence: ds:block?id=sqlite-pragmas-d6qmetcs; ds:block?id=sqlite-open-jda68c72; ds:block?id=sqlite-memory-kyedhky9. See docs/architecture.md and docs/operating-notes.md. Verified from the implementation and tests on 2026-11-01; server-test gates are explicitly distinguished from execution.
title: SQLite pragmas belong to connections
